title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Terms: Opening a Registry and Adding Items
content:
**1. When a registry can be created.** A registry of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry can be created when its event date is no more than the registry type's opening limit in full calendar months after the creation date, and no more than the type's late-opening limit in calendar days before the creation date. Both limits are the figures of the type's schedule of registry types and creation limits.

**2. Registrant and co-registrant.** The registrant is at least the registry type's minimum registrant age. A co-registrant is named only when the registry type allows a co-registrant.

**3. Visibility.** The registrant chooses a visibility from the type's visibility settings.

**4. Items.** Items are added while the registry is in active or completion status, up to the type's limit of distinct items and its limit of requested units per item. Gift cards are never registry items.

**5. Occasion and number.** Each registry type is offered for its own occasions, and the registry number follows the registry number format.

## Boundary cases on the opening window (hypothetical dates)

| Registry type figure | Creation date | Event date | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12-month opening limit | 15 January | 15 January of the following year (12 full calendar months later) | within the limit |
| 12-month opening limit | 15 January | 16 January of the following year | beyond the limit |
| 30-day late-opening limit | 31 March | 1 March (30 calendar days earlier) | within the limit |
| 30-day late-opening limit | 31 March | 28 February of a year that is not a leap year (31 calendar days earlier) | beyond the limit |
| 0-day late-opening limit | 31 March | 30 March | beyond the limit |

## Points of judgement

- A type whose late-opening limit is 0 days is opened on or before the event date.
- Items can still be added once the completion period has opened, because the registry is then in completion status; they cannot be added once it is closed or cancelled.
- *Hypothetical:* a registry type allowing 4 units of an item already shows that item at 4 requested units; raising it to 5 is beyond the type's per-item limit.
